feature: First run reaches the core value fast
acceptance: A new user completes the core action in under a minute without reading instructions; sample content or templates where it helps

feature: Every screen has designed empty / loading / error / offline states
acceptance: Each state is reachable in a test or storage-state fixture and appears in make ui-review screenshots

feature: Responsive from phone to desktop with 44 pt touch targets
acceptance: No clipping or horizontal scroll at 390 px; every tappable control at least 44 pt; reviewed at phone and desktop sizes
Contrast checked; labels for every control; full keyboard path; reduced motion respected; text usable at 200%

feature: App identity: name / icon / favicon / social preview / page titles
acceptance: Real name and icon set (all required sizes); meaningful titles and meta; no framework defaults left

feature: Destructive actions are undoable or confirmed
acceptance: Delete and reset offer undo (preferred) or confirmation; covered by a test

feature: Data survives: backup / export / import (or server sync)
acceptance: Users can export and restore their data; local-only data warns before it can be lost

feature: Errors are caught / shown kindly / and reported
acceptance: Error boundary with a recovery action; errors reach error tracking or the console with context
A preview or production URL (or store build) exists and is recorded in docs/production.md

feature: Light and dark themes are both intentional
acceptance: Both schemes reviewed; tokens drive every color
Meets the performance budget on a mid-range phone (web: LCP under 2.5 s / INP under 200 ms)

feature: Settings for the choices users expect
acceptance: Theme / data reset / and product-specific preferences in one place

feature: Installable (PWA) or store-ready build when used on phones
acceptance: Manifest and icons pass install checks / or a signed store build exists

feature: Privacy notice when personal data is stored or sent
acceptance: docs/legal templates completed for the data actually collected; analytics only with consent
Subtle transitions (150-250 ms) on state changes; immediate feedback on every tap
